items.title: Implement M3 adaptive runtime throttle semantics
items.context: Add bounded local runtime throttle logic with maxConcurrentLive, throttle_hold/throttle_raise/throttle_backoff events, stable-window raise, and overload/rate-limit backoff. Bind to Autopilot v2 M3 without claiming live fleet scale.
items.userSees: User sees "M3 adaptive throttle: PASS" in the Autopilot v2 acceptance table and smoke output.

happy.desc: maxConcurrentLive prevents more live dispatches than configured.

edge.desc: A stable window raises cautiously toward the cap; overload/rate-limit windows increase delay/backoff.

adversarial.desc: Invalid or zero maxConcurrentLive values clamp to a safe minimum and never allow unbounded concurrency.

verificationEvidence.note: PASS: adaptive throttle raises concurrency on stable windows.
PASS: throttle enforces maxConcurrentLive and hold behavior.
F-002 coverage fixed: reliability smoke now asserts maxConcurrentLive values 0, negative, NaN, and Infinity clamp to the safe minimum while preserving dispatch start eligibility.

items.title: Implement M4 process-pool claim lease and fencing semantics
items.context: Add bounded local process-pool coordination primitives: ownerWorkerId, leaseId, leaseExpiresAt, fencingToken, duplicate claim refusal, expired lease takeover, and stale worker commit refusal. Bind to Autopilot v2 M4 as control-plane semantics.
items.userSees: User sees "M4 process-pool claim/lease/fencing: PASS" in the Autopilot v2 acceptance table and smoke output.

happy.desc: N independent units can be claimed by distinct workers and completed once each under a bounded pool.

edge.desc: Expired claims can be taken over with a newer fencing token.

adversarial.desc: A stale worker with an old fencing token cannot commit after a newer claim exists.

verificationEvidence.note: PASS: current owner with current fencing token can complete a claimed step.
PASS: duplicate live claims are refused while lease is valid.
PASS: expired lease reclaim invalidates stale owner/fencing token and already-completed steps cannot be reclaimed.
